root_cause_criterion.criterion: At `OT::glyf_impl::SubsetGlyph::free_compiled_bytes()`, the pointer forwarded into `dest_start.fini()` must already refer to owned compiled storage rather than to the borrowed `source_glyph.get_bytes()` slice for the current glyph slot. The real fix enforces that ownership condition with `allocated`, so the borrowed slot chooses no free argument.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the cleanup free site with `free_argument` still equal to `source_glyph.get_bytes().arrayZ`, so `dest_start.fini()` forwards borrowed source-font bytes into `hb_free()`. The fixed original reaches the same source-grounded event with `free_argument == NULL` while `source_bytes_ptr` still names borrowed source bytes, proving the ownership guard suppressed the free.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The frozen required assertion is violated on the vulnerable original (`borrowed_free_guard.free_argument == borrowed_free_guard.source_bytes_ptr == 0x621000004f34`) and satisfied on the fixed original (`free_argument == NULL` while `source_bytes_ptr` remains a borrowed glyph slice), so no guarded fixed-side perturbation was needed.

nodes.state: `hb_array_t::fini()` reaches `hb_free((void *) arrayZ)` with `arrayZ` still equal to the borrowed `dest_start` pointer from the failing glyph slot, so the sink frees input-backed memory instead of HarfBuzz-owned storage.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `borrowed_free_guard.free_argument == bad_free_sink.free_argument`.

edges.relation: The exact pointer selected as the `dest_start.fini()` free argument is forwarded unchanged into `hb_array_t::fini()` and becomes the `hb_free()` argument at the bad-free sink.
